up: Show the first 200 metabolism records for CYP2C9. For each record, include the substrate structure (canonical SMILES), substrate compound name, the metabolic conversion description, pathway key, and the organism. Return the first 200 rows.
sql:
WITH cyp2c9_records AS (
  SELECT
    m.met_id,
    m.substrate_record_id,
    m.met_conversion,
    m.pathway_key,
    m.organism
  FROM metabolism m
  WHERE m.enzyme_name = 'CYP2C9'
  LIMIT 200
)
SELECT
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_name,
  r.met_conversion,
  r.pathway_key,
  r.organism
FROM cyp2c9_records r
JOIN compound_records cr ON r.substrate_record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno
